title: Warm Middle Eastern Harees Bowl
description: A keto twist on the traditional Middle Eastern dish, featuring slow-cooked harees with warm spices and silky textures.

ingredients.name: Harees
ingredients.notes: made from wheat and water, drained and rinsed

ingredients.name: Middle Eastern Spices
ingredients.notes: mix of cinnamon, cardamom, and allspice

instructions: In a large pot, combine harees and 4 cups of water. Bring to a boil, then reduce heat to low and simmer for 2 hours, or until harees is tender.
Preheat oven to 375°F (190°C). In a small bowl, mix together Middle Eastern Spices and Warm Cumin.
In a large skillet, heat 1 tsp of Keto Oil over medium heat. Add Ghee and fry for 1-2 minutes, or until fragrant.
Add the spice mixture to the skillet and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly.
Add the cooked harees to the skillet and stir to combine with the spice mixture.
Spoon the harees mixture into a bowl and top with Silky Labneh.
Garnish with Fresh Parsley and serve immediately.
Optional: Add a side of roasted vegetables or a simple green salad for a more substantial meal.
